# vergeio_tag_category (Resource)

Creates a tag category in VergeOS. Requires VergeOS v26 or later. A category groups tags and decides which object types those tags can be applied to. Tags in the category are `vergeio_tag`. Assign a tag to an object with `vergeio_tag_member`.

**Deleting a category deletes every tag in it and every assignment of those tags.** VergeOS does not ask for confirmation. The example sets `lifecycle.prevent_destroy` so an ordinary destroy cannot do that by accident. Remove `prevent_destroy` only when that cascade is what you want. Terraform warns on destroy that the category delete cascades.

`taggable_*` flags choose the object types the category applies to. Set a flag to `true` or `false` only when Terraform should manage it. Omit a flag to leave that object type unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent. Sending `false` for a flag you did not mean to set turns tagging off for that object type, including every VM when `taggable_vms` is `false`.

`single_tag_selection` works the same way. Omit it to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted value is not sent.

`vergeio_tag.category` is a number. Use `tonumber(vergeio_tag_category.example.id)`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deleting this category deletes every tag in it and every assignment of
# those tags. VergeOS does not ask for confirmation. prevent_destroy blocks
# an accidental destroy. Remove it only when that cascade is intentional.
#
# Only the taggable_* flags set here are sent. Leave the others unset so an
# update does not turn tagging off for those object types.

resource "vergeio_tag_category" "environment" {
  name                 = "environment"
  description          = "Environment classification"
  single_tag_selection = true
  taggable_vms         = true
  taggable_vnets       = true

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Category name. Must be unique.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Category description. Omit to leave an existing description unchanged.
- `single_tag_selection` (Boolean) When true, an object can have only one tag from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted value is not sent.
- `taggable_clusters` (Boolean) Whether clusters can use tags from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent.
- `taggable_groups` (Boolean) Whether groups can use tags from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent.
- `taggable_nodes` (Boolean) Whether nodes can use tags from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent.
- `taggable_sites` (Boolean) Whether sites can use tags from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent.
- `taggable_tenant_nodes` (Boolean) Whether tenant nodes can use tags from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent.
- `taggable_tenants` (Boolean) Whether tenants can use tags from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent.
- `taggable_users` (Boolean) Whether users can use tags from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent.
- `taggable_vmware_containers` (Boolean) Whether VMware containers can use tags from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent.
- `taggable_vms` (Boolean) Whether VMs can use tags from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent.
- `taggable_vnet_rules` (Boolean) Whether network rules can use tags from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent.
- `taggable_vnets` (Boolean) Whether networks can use tags from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent.
- `taggable_volumes` (Boolean) Whether volumes can use tags from this category. Omit to leave the current value unchanged. An omitted flag is not sent.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tag category key assigned by VergeOS.

## Import

Import is supported using the category key.

```shell
terraform import vergeio_tag_category.example <id>
```
